About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.
We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company .

Checkr Trust is building safer communities by providing our customers with risk signals about its users. Every year, our team provides insights on tens of millions of users across multiple verticals: online dating, car rental, short-term rentals, and many more. We acquire, analyze, and deliver insights in smart, scalable ways that help organizations identify and mitigate risk.
Trust is part of the Checkr start-up lab: we operate with the speed of a small startup, while enjoying the leverage and resources of a known technology brand.
Since launching, we’ve seen significant growth and we are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in the continued growth of our startup. As part of our small team, you will be empowered to take significant end-to-end ownership - from idea to execution to real customer and business impact.

Work closely with customers, engineers, and leaders to design, build, and launch new products.
Take full ownership of the entire process of developing end-to-end applications – from shaping the idea to delivering the finished application.
Build and improve APIs, including integrating with third-party services to expand what our products can do.
Embrace a customer-centric, product-first approach – partner directly with customer success, customers and stakeholders to better understand their needs and turn those into useful features.
Keep code reliable and easy to maintain with solid testing, thoughtful reviews, and good practices.
Run and measure product experiments, using what you learn to guide future development.
Building scalable APIs and asynchronous event-based architecture that can reliably handle very high traffic.

BS/MS degree in either computer science or an engineering discipline.
Have founded or held early roles at successful fast-paced startups.
5+ years of full stack software development experience.
Advanced knowledge in Ruby (Rails), Javascript (React), or similar languages/frameworks.
Experimentation mindset: autonomy and empowerment to validate a customer need, get team buy-in, and ship a rapid MVP.
Early-stage approach: comfort with ambiguity, balancing speed and perfection, and the confidence and curiosity to help guide product direction.
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Experience building scalable technical architecture that can scale to 10mm+ users (including observability tooling, container orchestration, etc).
Background in trust & safety, IDV, background check products or criminal data.
Expertise in data analysis and processing.
Experience building and working with scrapers and scraping technology

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

Join the pioneering Servicing International team at the forefront of Affirm 's global expansion, building the foundational platform to launch our products into a new generation of international markets.

This role will focus specifically on purchase protection, including disputes and refunds—a critical part of the user journey and an area of significant investment—to ensure trust and satisfaction for our newest customers.

Success requires deep collaboration, and you will partner closely with European engineering counterparts and engineers across our global Servicing Engineering organization to build cohesive, scalable solutions.

If you are passionate about creating world-class user experiences and excited by the challenge of launching products in new regions, join us. Help build the next generation of Affirm 's platform and define our presence around the world.

What You'll Do · You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery. · You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs. · You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them. · You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts. · You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. · You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For · You have a total of 4+ years of experience as a software engineer. · You are experienced in designing, developing, and launching backend systems at scale using Python, Kotlin, or similar backend languages , alongside technologies like AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes. · You’ve had exposure to building web apps with declarative UI frameworks (e.g., React or Vue ) and understand the core principles behind them. · You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design.

You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. · You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. · Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. · You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is one of its first engineering hires. The Enterprise Platform team is brand new. You will not be inheriting a mature system or a long backlog: you will own core domains of the platform that turns the internal systems enabling Discordians into self-service software.
Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software.

Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals.

As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.

Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.
Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.
Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.
Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.
Own your domain end to end: Take core components of the platform from design through production with no code boundaries, writing the RFCs and documentation for the areas you own.
What You Should Have
3+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning projects end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Go, Python, and TypeScript), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.
Hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and working fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.
Experience treating endpoint or infrastructure configuration as an API-driven engineering surface rather than console work.
A platform-as-a-product mindset. You care whether people actually adopt what you build, not just whether it ships.
Comfort owning complex, multi-milestone projects through ambiguity, and energy for building in a greenfield environment.

Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.
Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.
Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

As a member of our Business Systems Engineering team, you will build or improve tools that are used daily by Go to Market teams. Our goal is to find bottlenecks and friction points, and drive process improvements as well as come up with technical solutions. Our team is the custodian of data that is used by sales, order, finance, support teams. We emphasize automation over operation, metrics over anecdotes, iteration over perfection and being proactive over responsive.
We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

Design and implement technical solutions that will span between AWS, Salesforce and NetSuite
Improve systems observability and invest in reliability & correctness of data
Develop customer empathy to propose improvements to systems
Lead projects from ideation to release
Help and mentor junior engineers

In-depth expertise in distributed systems and data processing
AWS Cloud experience touching foundational blocks like: Kubernetes, Fargate, Lambda, Airflow, Athena, DynamoDB, VPC, and EC2.

Iterable is the leading AI-powered customer engagement platform that helps leading brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box create dynamic, individualized experiences at scale.

Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data, design seamless cross-channel interactions, and optimize engagement—all with enterprise-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences.
Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values—Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, Transparency —to life. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and inclusion, where ideas are valued and individuals are empowered to do their best work.

That’s why we’ve been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces and Fastest Growing Companies , and were recognized on Forbes’ list of America’s Best Startup Employers in 2022. Notably, Iterable has also been listed on Wealthfront’s Career Launching Companies List and has held a top 10 ranking on the Top 25 Companies Where Women Want to Work .
With a global presence—including offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide—we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together!
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Developer Platform Team, you will improve the platform foundations that Iterable engineers rely on to build, test, deploy, and operate services safely at scale. Your work will span the developer workflow end-to-end: from Scala, Bazel, and CI systems, through deployment workflows and self-service platforms, down to the Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure that make those experiences reliable in practice.
This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who is equally comfortable improving the inner loop for developers and owning the production platform systems behind it. You will lead high-leverage projects across build, test, deployment, and runtime infrastructure; drive work that reduces developer friction while improving reliability and cost efficiency; and partner closely with product engineering, infrastructure, security, and SRE to turn platform pain points into durable solutions.
Own the developer delivery path end to end: Improve the systems engineers' use to build, test, package, deploy, and validate changes with confidence across local development, CI, and production rollout workflows.
Lead shared engineering foundations: Evolve common libraries, build patterns, service templates, internal platform capabilities, and paved-path workflows that many teams depend on.

Grafana Labs , the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale.

With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions.

Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost.

We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring The Opportunity: The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.

Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.

The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.

The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software.

We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.

What you'll be doing: As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:

Own features end-to-end across the stack : from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React

Design and evolve systems, not just features : contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales

Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform

Make the product operable at enterprise scale : the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables and iterate quickly based on feedback

Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation : our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature

Be a part of the team's on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running
We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Technologies you'll work with:
Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)
TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)
Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure
k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)
Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)

You are comfortable working in a remote-first company ; communication is key.
For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful . We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.

Strong Go, or a path to it. We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.

We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.
Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.
We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.
We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production — capacities, costs, constraints — and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.
Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on screen.

The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture, and more than that.
We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.
What you'll own
The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.
The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team.
Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers.
Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.
How we work
Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them.
Feedback runs both ways and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.
We like this work, and you'll notice. The energy of a small team that cares is what people remember about being here. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems.
Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily.
Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals.
Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance).
Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow.
Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior.
Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away.
You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight.
You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool.
You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work.
German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.
NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.
Nice to have: a substantial migration you carried out end to end (system, stack, or data) · telemetry and observability · Cloudflare or comparable serverless infrastructure · frontend experience, ideally with Solid.js or another reactive framework · optimization/OR exposure · manufacturing or ERP data experience.
You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far.
This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan.

Impact. You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed.
Ownership. What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's.
The people next to you. You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer and with our research engineers on the optimization engine, and you build on eye level with the founders.
Shaping. You shape how this team works, not just what it builds. The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. This is a place for system thinkers: the interesting part isn't writing the code, it's seeing how the pieces fit and where they'll break. The company is early; your scope will grow with it.
Feedback speed. You will know directly what you are up to, we speak out loud, we adjust, we grow. Together.
High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
The basics. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.
Process: first conversation, 20 minutes, with me or with the engineer who owns our frontend. Second conversation with the two of us together; this is where the technical questions get deep. Then a hands-on challenge, about three hours of your time, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it.

Finally, the team: online first, then in person at the office. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.
To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about your favorite system you have built, and one decision in it, you would reverse today.
"Hustle the day, analyze at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

To be considered for a role with a British Government client through mthree, you must meet specific eligibility criteria and, if successful, complete the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and, where required, Security Check (SC) clearance.

Du interessierst dich für moderne Applikationsentwicklung in einem grossen Konzern und möchtest dein Wissen in einem internationalen SAP\-Umfeld aufbauen?

In unserem Team erhältst du die Möglichkeit, während eines ein\- bis zweijährigen Praktikums wertvolle Praxiserfahrung zu sammeln und aktiv an spannenden Aufgaben im Bereich Unternehmensanwendungen mitzuarbeiten. Du wirst von erfahrenen Praxisbildnern begleitet und Schritt für Schritt an anspruchsvolle Themen herangeführt.

Am Ende deines letzten Praktikumsjahres hast du die Möglichkeit, mit deiner individuellen praktischen Arbeit (IPA) den Abschluss als Informatikerin \| Informatiker EFZ Fachrichtung Applikationsentwicklung zu erwerben.
Du arbeitest in einem kollegialen, hilfsbereiten Team im Modul «SAP Finance und Controlling» und erhältst Einblick in moderne Technologien, Prozesse und Projektarbeit. Dabei lernst du nicht nur die technische Umsetzung, sondern auch das strukturierte Aufnehmen, Konzipieren und Realisieren von Anforderungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Kundinnen und Kunden.

Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP\-Lösungen im FI/CO\-Umfeld (Schwerpunkt ABAP OO) sowie Erstellung benutzerfreundlicher Anwendungen mit SAP Fiori und OData\-Services.
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Schnittstellen (z. B. EDI/Seeburger), API\-Integration und sichere Datenübertragung. Erste Aufgaben auf der SAP BTP.
Fehleranalyse und Support: systematische Bearbeitung technischer und fachlicher Fragestellungen sowie Problemlösung im Supportumfeld.
Analyse, Priorisierung und Umsetzung von Change Requests. Mitwirkung in Projekten und Umsetzen neuer Anforderungen.
Aufnahme von Anforderungen bei internen Kundinnen \| Kunden, Ausarbeitung strukturierter Konzepte und technischer Lösungen.
Selbstständige Recherche und Wissensaufbau, Pflege technischer Dokumentationen.
Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche (z. B. SAP BW/BI) und Mitarbeit in internationalen Projekten.

Du bist im 2\. oder 3\. Lehrjahr der Ausbildung zur Applikationsentwicklerin \| Applikationsentwickler und suchst ein ein\- bis zweijähriges Praktikum.
Du bist neugierig und lernbereit und möchtest dich vertieft in neue Technologien und Themen einarbeiten.
Logisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Durchhaltevermögen und Eigeninitiative, du übernimmst gern Verantwortung und arbeitest zunehmend selbstständig.
Interesse an Unternehmensprozessen, insbesondere an Finanz\- und Controlling\-Themen neben der technischen Entwicklung.
Du bist teamfähig und kommunikativ und trittst offen und professionell gegenüber internen Kundinnen \| Kunden auf und arbeitest gerne mit Entwicklerinnen \| Entwicklern, Beraterinnen \| Beratern und Fachbereichen zusammen.

Praxisnahes Praktikum in einem vielseitigen SAP\-Umfeld mit Mitarbeit an realen Projekten sowie Einblicken in Entwicklungs\- und Supportprozesse.
Fundierte Begleitung durch erfahrene Praxisbildner und ein hilfsbereites, kollegiales Team mit starkem Zusammenhalt.
Einsatz und Kennenlernen moderner Technologien: ABAP, SAP Fiori, OData, BTP, EDI/Seeburger sowie SAP FI/CO und BW/BI.

Als zentrale Beschaffungsstelle der Bundesverwaltung beschaffen wir sicherheitsrelevante Systeme sowie Güter und sind zuständig für das Technologie\- und Immobilienmanagement des VBS.
Der Kompetenzbereich Wissenschaft und Technologie (W\+T) ist zuständig für die wissenschaftliche Beurteilung von Technologieaspekten militärischer Systeme auf ihrem Lebensweg, führt Risikoanalysen durch und erstellt Sicherheitskonzepte. Ferner ist W\+T im Auftrag des VBS verantwortlich für die Forschung in Technologiebereichen mit Relevanz für die Sicherheitspolitik der Schweiz.

You will join the API Enterprise team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem.

We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.
We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How.

Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs.

Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities.

At VREY , we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings .
Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.
At the same time, regulation is forcing property owners into major investment: solar is becoming mandatory, smart meters must be rolled out nationwide within five years, heating and mobility are electrifying. The apartment building is transforming from passive real estate into an active part of the decentralised energy infrastructure.
What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.
VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software , enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:
Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,
~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and
digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.
We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. In the course of our seed financing, we raised €3.3M from leading impact and energy VCs (including Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, and Kopa Ventures). We're now entering the next growth phase and expanding our team.
We're at the beginning of a structural market shift. Join us and help build the leading EnergyOS.
Your Profile
You have 2+ years of professional experience building and running full-stack web applications, ideally with Ruby on Rails . Experience in comparable frameworks (Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, NextJS) will also be considered, if you are truly motivated to learn and work with Rails.
You have a strong understanding and hands-on experience designing and optimizing relational database schemas (we use PostgreSQL ).
You are used to working with APIs and integrating with 3rd-party services.
You have solid experience setting up and maintaining cloud/server infrastructure. We have a basic Heroku setup and Github CI/CD and need to gradually scale and improve monitoring etc.
You have at least basic frontend development skills, ideally with solid fundamentals (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), as well as familiarity with both the Rails way (Hotwire, Turbo and Stimulus) and a framework like React or Vue.
You are actively working with AI and pushing for efficient agentic setups; we are establishing Claude Code in the team and the whole company.
You like to take ownership for the features and components you work on and you are proactive in the product development.
You are excited about startups and want to make a real impact on the product and the company in a truely agile way.
You are based in Berlin (or willing to relocate). You will enjoy working in our office in Friedrichshain with the team most of the time, with the flexibility of 1-2 remote work days a week.
You are willing to learn energy industry terms in English and German and being comfortable with some parts of the company operating mostly in German. (Team language is English.)
Nice to have: You have experience working with multi-tenancy systems and/or are experienced with payment provider integration (e.g., Stripe Connect)

You will be an early member of our growing product development team, working across the entire stack.
The core functionality of the VREY platform is processing smart meter measurement data for analyzing and billing solar power usage. For this purpose, we provide landlords and tenants with a portal and automate contract management, invoicing and payment flows. An admin interface and integration with internal tools enable the creation and management of projects by our operations team.
While working on features and integrations, you also help us improve our infrastructure and backend processes, enabling our platform to scale.
1. Full-stack feature development
You co-design and build features across the full stack, from database to UI.
You work directly with product management, design and internal users to get the details right.
You ensure that our features perform well for a growing number of users.
2. Data processing, automation and reliability
You co-own the development of our crucial backend processes: importing and processing of smart meter measurement data and automated billing.
You help designing and maintaining the underlying server infrastructure.
You instrument, optimize and monitor critical processes so they remain fast, reliable and dependable as we scale.
3. Technical design, architecture and engineering excellence
You research, evaluate and design technical solutions to new problems together with the team.
You contribute to our aspiration to get better and more efficient as engineers and as a team every day.
You continuously improve our development environment and engineering processes, including adopting the right tools, workflows and AI-powered development practices.

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Platform team.

Our Engineering and Product Design teams are building multiple verticals on our platform at high speed, leveraging AI and building agentic functionality into the platform itself. As we scale into the world's largest regulated financial institutions, identity and access management (IAM), authorization, and fine-grained permissions have become foundational to our enterprise readiness.
We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to join the team building Taktile's IAM and permissions platform : the authorization backbone that powers enterprise-grade access control across our product.
Joining us, you'll design and build permission models and access controls end-to-end, from the React/TypeScript access-management and admin UIs down to the Python (FastAPI) authorization services. You'll take on the problems that make enterprise authorization genuinely hard: multi-tenant isolation , fine-grained permission checks in the hot path of millions of decisions a day, audit and access trails , and the constraints of regulated financial services .

Design, build, and operate core authorization primitives such as roles, policies, and fine-grained permission checks (RBAC/ReBAC), along with the authentication and SSO/OAuth/OIDC flows that sit on top of them.
Guarantee strict multi-tenant isolation so every customer's data and decisions stay fully segregated.
Keep fine-grained permission checks fast in the hot path of millions of automated decisions per day, where both latency and correctness are non-negotiable.
Build audit and access-trail capabilities that give customers and auditors a verifiable record of who accessed what, when, and why.
Design for regulated-industry constraints (financial services, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, data residency), where access control is a compliance requirement, not just a feature.
Leverage leading edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to build industry-shaping AI-native capabilities.

Strong proficiency with React and TypeScript.

Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

Was sind SolidFlow -Batterien?
SolidFlow -Batterien speichern Energie in organischen Molekülen. Der Verzicht auf explosive Materialien macht sie sicher, der Einsatz von sozial und ökologisch konfliktfreien Rohstoffen nachhaltig und die nahezu unbegrenzte Materialverfügbarkeit skalierbar und günstig in der Beschaffung. Das macht unsere patentierte SolidFlow - Technologie zu einem Gamechanger im Aufbau eines globalen klimaneutralen Energiesystems.
Vom Start-up zum Scale-up: Gemeinsam packen wir es an
CMBlu Energy entwickelt sich von einem Start-up mit Forschungsschwerpunkt zu einem produzierenden Scale-up, das sich auf dem Sprung in die Serienproduktion befindet. An diesem Ziel arbeiten rund 250 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bei CMBlu Energy. Unser Hauptsitz ist in Alzenau nähe Frankfurt , mit einer Zwei g stelle in Obernburg. Hinzu kommen Tochtergesellschaften in Athen, Griechenland und Petaluma, USA.
Deine Mission
Möchtest du Software, Datenpipelines und KI bauen, die Batterieforschung schneller machen? Bei uns entwickelst du die Systeme, die aus unseren Forschungs-, Pilot- und Produktionsdaten bessere Materialien und Zellen machen – und die KI-Werkzeuge, mit denen unsere Chemie- und Elektrochemie-Teams jeden Tag arbeiten.
Du bist stark in der Software-Entwicklung, hast ein Faible für Daten und echten Bock auf KI in ihrer ganzen Breite – von LLMs und Agenten bis zu klassischem Machine Learning. Sauberes Engineering verbindest du mit Databricks, Azure und Claude zu Werkzeugen, die es so nicht von der Stange gibt.
Damit gibst du unserer Forschung nicht nur Daten, sondern Antworten – und den Hebel, schneller die richtigen Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Deine Aufgaben
Produktionsreife Software entwickeln – APIs, Services und interne Web-Apps in modernem Python (uv, FastAPI/uvicorn), mit sauberer Architektur, Tests und CI/CD; etwa Analyse-Apps, mit denen Forschende ihre Testdaten auswerten, als Databricks Apps über Asset Bundles und GitLab deployt.

About CoLab At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner. CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions.

Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design.

Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster. Founded in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company.

We've recently been recognized on Deloitte's Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post. About the Role Modern engineering teams invest a significant amount of time and money on simulation.

Before anything gets built, teams need confidence that a design is going to work: structurally, thermally, aerodynamically, etc. Simulation is one of the main ways they build that confidence. But the way teams share and review simulation results to make decisions is still pretty broken.

Engineers are exporting videos, taking screenshots, dropping them into PowerPoint, and then trying to make decisions through email threads, meetings, or disconnected slide decks.

The actual decision-making ends up separated from the underlying simulation data, which means context gets lost, feedback is hard to trace, and important engineering knowledge disappears into the workflow. CoLab already helps engineering teams review CAD, capture feedback, and make better design decisions in one connected workspace.

Now we’re extending that same idea into simulation. The goal is simple: make simulation results collaborative, reviewable, and traceable in the same way CoLab does for CAD today. We’re starting a new product team focused on bringing simulation review into CoLab.

As one of the first engineers on that team, you’ll help define how simulation data gets ingested, visualized, discussed, and connected back to real engineering decisions.

There are a lot of interesting technical problems here: large datasets, high-performance visualization, viewer interactions, data pipelines, and user experiences that need to work for mechanical engineers doing critical product development work.

The first phase is about learning the product, the customers, and the review workflows we already support today. You’ll spend time embedded with our Engineering Reviews team, learning how engineers collaborate in CoLab, where the current product is strong, and where simulation creates a new set of problems we need to solve.

From there, you’ll help build the foundation for a new Simulation team - not just technically, but from a product perspective as well. We want to build something customers actually need and will use in their day-to-day work, and that requires a highly product oriented approach.

Our Ideal Candidate You're the kind of developer who wants to understand why a feature matters before deciding how to build it. You enjoy owning complex technical problems, but you also enjoy talking with product managers, designers, and customers to understand what success actually looks like.

You make thoughtful technical decisions independently and know when to bring others into the conversation. Experience working with simulation software is a significant advantage. Maybe you've worked with FEA, CFD, multiphysics simulations, scientific visualization, or engineering data platforms.

You understand the kinds of problems engineers are trying to solve. This is a good fit for someone who likes ambiguity, wants to work closely with our product and leadership teams, and cares about the connection between technical decisions and customer value.

You’ll have a meaningful role in shaping both the architecture and the user experience for a new capability that we think can become a major part of engineering review in CoLab. What You'll Do
Help design and build CoLab's next-generation simulation review capabilities.
Build services that ingest and process simulation data from industry-standard engineering software.
Develop high-performance visualization experiences capable of displaying large simulation datasets.
Partner closely with Product, Design, and customers to validate ideas before building them.
Spend time embedded with the Engineering Reviews team to develop deep product and customer understanding before transitioning onto the Simulation team.
Contribute to architectural decisions that will shape this product area for years to come.
Improve performance, scalability, and reliability as simulation capabilities grow.
Collaborate with engineers across the platform to ensure simulation becomes a seamless part of the broader CoLab experience.

AI Enablement is the team that builds the AI infrastructure the rest of Clara's engineering org runs on. We're not a team that "adds AI to a product" — we build the tools other teams build with.

Live examples today: Clara Builders (an internal skills marketplace and self-service app platform), an agent that turns Figma designs directly into production code through MCP, a documentation agent that keeps internal knowledge in sync with the codebases it describes, and n8n automations already running in production across several business teams.
We're looking for a senior engineer to own the frontend architecture of Clara Builders and go deep on the systems behind it — backend services, agent infrastructure, and the AI tooling other teams across Clara rely on. This is deliberately not a frontend-only role: you'll be expected to move into backend and infra whenever the problem calls for it, and to build AI tooling yourself rather than just apply it to your own tickets.
Concretely, Clara Builders is a Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript app on Prisma/Postgres, with a self-service Dokploy deploy pipeline (staging → beta → production, gated by a pending/approved environment lifecycle) and a Cloudflare AI Gateway layer that proxies multiple LLM providers behind one internal endpoint.

You'd be joining while we're actively building the next layer on top of that: OAuth Clients support and unified access proposals, both in progress and largely undocumented today — you'd be shaping them, not inheriting a finished spec.
We move fast and trust our engineers to own outcomes end-to-end. That means autonomy to make decisions, proactivity to surface problems before they become blockers, and the attitude to push initiatives across the finish line without waiting to be told what to do.

More about Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions).

By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally.

We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.
The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.
While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.
Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.
Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:
Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS channels every year.
Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.
Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company.
We have raised over $750 million USD of private capital and are backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. s.h: What does the team work on?
s.t:
At Roku, the UI team builds the foundational frameworks, tooling, and high-performance UI components that power experiences across millions of devices. We own the middleware and UI layers that enable smooth navigation, responsive interactions, rich animations, and consistent developer workflows across the platform.
Our work spans graphics rendering, layout and animation systems, performance optimization, and developer APIs that make it easy to create reliable, visually compelling applications at scale. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment and partner closely with firmware, platform, and product teams to ensure the end-to-end experience is fast, robust, and future-ready.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the UI team, you'll design, implement, and optimize systems that underpin Roku's user experience and developer platform. You'll work on performance-critical code paths across graphics rendering, animation, layout, and UI frameworks, ensuring smooth visuals and highly responsive interactions across a wide range of devices.
At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents — setting context, planning work, verifying outputs, and recovering when the agent goes off course.

You'll play a key role in shaping core architecture, working across the stack with hardware, firmware, and application teams, and delivering solutions that directly impact tens of millions of users.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy deep technical problem-solving, care about performance at a systems level, want to build the foundational layers that power great user experiences — and are energized by the shift to agentic engineering. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you.
How will I use AI at Roku?
At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

s.h: As a Senior Software Engineer on the Convert team, you'll

Design, build, and operate the distributed backend systems behind our recommendations pipeline and our AI workflow execution engine, primarily in Python and TypeScript/Node.js.
Own and harden the infrastructure our products run on, including our AI workflow platform on AWS and Kubernetes: improving reliability, observability, and scalability, not just consuming infra built elsewhere.
Strengthen how our systems handle failure: eventing and streaming, retries, backpressure, and recovery, so a single outage doesn't turn into days of replay.

BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
